question: Should OpenClaw treat revisiting any agent already in the propagated sessions_send route as a cycle that fails before delivery?
rationale: The implementation path is bounded, but it intentionally changes existing multi-agent revisit behavior from delivery into an error, so maintainer product and compatibility intent is required before merge.

options.title: Accept fail-closed cycle blocking after proof
options.body: Land the rebased provenance-chain guard once the contributor supplies real multi-agent proof and fixes the duplicate error-chain wording.

options.title: Preserve cyclic revisits
options.body: Reject or rework the guard if legitimate workflows must revisit an agent in the same route without a tool error.

options.title: Require explicit route policy
options.body: Pause this PR until maintainers choose an opt-in, thresholded, or documented route policy for agent revisits.

recommendation.title: Accept fail-closed cycle blocking after proof
recommendation.body: Land the rebased provenance-chain guard once the contributor supplies real multi-agent proof and fixes the duplicate error-chain wording.
